channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Silver climbs near $57 despite renewed Fed rate hike expectations
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) advances toward $56.90 per troy ounce on Monday at the time of writing, gaining 1.62% on the day. The precious metal continues to benefit from safe-haven demand as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East keep risk sentiment under pressure.

item.title: Euro: Policy divergence supports gains against US Dollar - DBS
item.description: DBS Group Research’s Philip Wee argues that the Euro (EUR) may find support in coming weeks as markets reassess geopolitical risks and central bank divergence.

item.title: British Pound: Market calm under Burnham’s cautious agenda – ING
item.description: James Smith at ING highlights that UK markets have reacted calmly to Andy Burnham becoming prime minister, with risk premia contained as investors expect no major policy shocks this year.

item.title: Breaking: Canada's headline CPI rose by 2.8% YoY in June
item.description: Canada’s inflation has cooled a tad in June, with the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rising 2.8% from a year earlier, coming in below market expectations and down from the 3.2% increase recorded in May. On a monthly basis, prices declined by 0.4%.

item.title: Houthis declare naval blockade against Saudi Arabia, raising Middle East tensions
item.description: Yemen's Houthis announced on Monday a naval blockade against Saudi Arabia, according to a statement reported by Reuters.

item.title: Norwegian Krone: Range trading view holds against Euro – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s Jane Foley notes that softer Norwegian inflation has tempered expectations for further Norges Bank tightening, even after May’s 25 bps hike to 4.25%.

item.title: European Central Bank: Oil risks support a September rate hike – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s rates team expects higher oil prices and weak growth signals to shape Thursday’s European Central Bank (ECB) meeting. A July rate hike is effectively ruled out, while markets have fully priced in another 25bp move in September.

item.title: United Kingdom: Softer CPI supports prolonged BoE hold – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities’ Julie Ioffe expects United Kingdom (UK) headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) to slow to 2.7% year-on-year in June, in line with consensus but below Bank of England (BoE) projections, as lower fuel prices offset sticky Services. Core CPI is seen at 2.6% and Services at 3.6%.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bearish Flag formation backs more downside
item.description: The Euro (EUR) trades marginally lower near 1.1432 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Monday. The major currency pair edges down as the US Dollar recovers its early losses.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: Sticky inflation supports more RBNZ hikes – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad expects New Zealand Q2 Consumer Price Index (CPI) to remain well above target, with quarterly and annual readings only slightly below the RBNZ’s own projections.

item.title: Australian Dollar picks up above 0.7000 as risk aversion eases
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) appreciates against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday, as comments from Iranian Foreign Minister Esmaeil Baghaei offered a glimmer of hope for de-escalation in Iran and pushed Oil prices down from one-month highs.

item.title: Iran: Mediators propose 10-day cessation of strikes to revive US-Iran interim deal
item.description: According to a senior Iranian official, mediators have proposed a 10-day cessation of strikes to find ways to revive the interim deal between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Oil: Geopolitical shocks tighten crude and diesel markets – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank says renewed U.S.-Iran tensions, Russia-Ukraine strikes and CPC loading disruptions have lifted crude and refining margins sharply. Brent briefly topped $90, while severe diesel-market tightness is feeding through to export policy and U.S. pump prices.

item.title: Indian Rupee struggles for comeback amid continued FIIs selling
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades slightly lower against the US Dollar (USD) in late trading hours on Monday. The USD/INR pair is mildly higher to near 96.46 at the time of writing as the consistent outflow of foreign funds from the Indian stock market is hurting the Indian currency.

item.title: Indian Rupee: RBI support as INR nears record low against US Dollar – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu reports that the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has intervened onshore and offshore to support the Indian Rupee (INR) as USD/INR trades close to its all‑time high.

item.title: US Dollar Index: Higher energy supports DXY recovery – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner notes that deteriorating Gulf headlines and higher energy prices are keeping the Dollar supported, even if US Dollar Index (DXY) remains about 1% below its June peak.

item.title: WTI Oil rally takes a breather as Tehran leaves the door open to diplomacy
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil trades around $81.30 on Monday at the time of writing, down 0.54% on the day as investors take some profits following the commodity's sharp rally in recent weeks.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling rally seen nearing exhaustion against Euro – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong argue recent British Pound (GBP) strength looks stretched as markets price in fiscal discipline from the new UK government under Andy Burnham.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD nears the tip of a triangle formation at the $4,000 area
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) shows marginal gains on Monday, as the US Dollar recovery stalled and Oil prices pulled back from highs. The precious metal remains capped below a descending trendline resistance, but downside attempts remain supported above the $3,965 area, thus forming a descending triangle pattern

item.title: UK PM Starmer: My work is done
item.description: United Kingdom (UK) Prime Minister (PM) Keir Starmer, the seventh PM since Britain’s exit from the European Union (EU), delivers his resignation to King Charles at Buckingham Palace.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Flatlines around 218.50 with long-term highs at hand
item.description: GBP/JPY wavers around 218.50, with bears contained above previous highs at 218.00.

item.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ expectations skewed to upside – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad expects Japan’s June Consumer Price Index (CPI) to edge higher across headline and core measures, with core ex fresh food and energy steady at 1.8%.

item.title: Euro: Growth validation needed for value case – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu argues that Euro (EUR) assets show emerging value as the European Central Bank (ECB) holds policy and inflation pressures ease, but stresses that Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data and earnings must confirm stable growth.

item.title: Euro holds steady vs Japanese Yen ahead of ECB, BoJ meetings
item.description: EUR/JPY trades around 185.70 on Monday at the time of writing, showing little direction after a quiet start to the week.

item.title: CEE FX: Risk-off keeps pressure on forint – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky notes that escalating US-Iran tensions are driving risk-off sentiment, overshadowing a light Central and Eastern Europe data calendar.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: Lags as MNB cuts loom – Societe Generale
item.description: Société Générale identifies the Hungarian forint as July’s main Central and Eastern European (CEE) laggard, with EUR/HUF moving back above 363 as markets anticipate another 25bp central bank of Hungary Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB) rate cut to 5.75%.

item.title: Iran's Baghaei: Intermediaries share messages with Tehran over recent days
item.description: Esmaeil Baghaei Hamaneh, a spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran, said during the European trading session on Monday that Tehran pursues war and diplomacy based on its national interests when asked whether the door to talks with the United States (US) was now closed, Reuters repor

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Monday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $56.83 per troy ounce, up 1.49% from the $56.00 it cost on Friday.

item.title: Brent: Energy risks rise with Hormuz tensions – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets team highlights that Brent Oil trading near $90 and elevated crack spreads underscore tight energy conditions as geopolitical risks escalate around Iran and Hormuz.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises against Japanese Yen due to RBA-BoJ rate differential
item.description: AUD/JPY rises after two days of losses, trading around 113.60 during the European hours on Monday. The currency cross appreciates as the Australian Dollar (AUD) holds gains following the release of the interest rate decision by the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), China's central bank.
